actions.compress_pdf.description: Reduces the file size of a PDF document while maintaining readability.
actions.compress_pdf.props.optimizeProfi: Controls the trade-off between file size and output quality.
actions.convert_to_pdf.description: Converts a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or image file to PDF format.
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.file.descri: The file to convert. Supported formats: DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF.
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.filename.de: Name for the resulting PDF file (without the .pdf extension). Defaults to the original filename.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.merge_pdfs.description: Combines two or more PDF files into a single PDF document.
actions.merge_pdfs.props.file1.descripti: The first PDF file to merge. It will appear first in the merged result.
actions.merge_pdfs.props.file2.descripti: The second PDF file to merge.
actions.merge_pdfs.props.filename.descri: Name for the merged PDF file (without the .pdf extension).
actions.pdf_to_image.description: Converts one or more pages of a PDF file to an image.
actions.pdf_to_image.props.file.descript: The PDF file to convert to an image.
actions.pdf_to_image.props.pageNrs.descr: Pages to convert. Examples: "1" (first page only), "1,3,5" (specific pages), "2-5" (range), "all" (every page). Defaults to the first page.
actions.pdf_to_image.props.widthPixel.de: Output image width in pixels. Height is calculated automatically to maintain the page aspect ratio.
actions.pdf_to_word.description: Converts a PDF file to an editable Microsoft Word (DOCX) document.
actions.pdf_to_word.props.file.descripti: The PDF file to convert to Word format.
actions.pdf_to_word.props.language.descr: Language of the text in the PDF. Used to improve OCR accuracy.
actions.pdf_to_word.props.mergeAllSheets: Merge all pages into a single Word document sheet.
Automatically apply OCR when the PDF contains scanned images instead of selectable text.
actions.pdf_to_word.props.qualityType.de: Draft processes the entire file in one API call. High uses per-page processing — best for scanned or image-heavy PDFs.
actions.protect_pdf.description: Adds password protection to a PDF file so only authorised users can open it.
actions.protect_pdf.props.file.descripti: The PDF file to protect with a password.
actions.protect_pdf.props.password.descr: The password users will need to open the protected PDF.
Permissions granted to users who open the protected PDF.
actions.split_pdf.description: Splits a PDF file into multiple documents using one of four split strategies.
actions.split_pdf.props.splitAction.desc: How the PDF should be split.
actions.split_pdf.props.splitAction.opti: Recurring Split — split into equal chunks every N pages
Split After Page — split into two parts at a given page
Split Ranges — split using custom page ranges
Split Sequence — split by a sequence of page counts
auth.description:

1. Go to your [API Keys dashboard](https://dev.pdf4me.com/dashboard/#/api-keys/)
2. Sign in or create a free account if you don't have one
3. Copy your API key and paste it here
